create_ClipModel: create a ClipModel instance from a CLIP model and model name for zero-shot classification
compute_zeroshot_weights: compute zero-shot classification weights from class names and text templates
get_image_embeddings: get normalized image embeddings from a tensor of input images
get_text_embeddings: get normalized text embeddings from a list of caption strings
get_zeroshot_predictions: get zero-shot class predictions by comparing image embeddings to text weights
